subject: System Design
title: Synchronous vs Asynchronous Communication
description: One-minute skill: Synchronous vs Asynchronous Communication.

hook.text: A phone call is synchronous — both sides must be present. A text message is asynchronous.

buildup.text: Sync communication blocks the caller until the response arrives. Async lets the caller continue working.

discovery.text: HTTP requests are synchronous. Message queues and event buses enable asynchronous communication.

twist.text: Async is faster but harder to debug. When something fails, tracing the chain of events is complex.

climax.text: Most systems use both: sync for user-facing calls, async for background processing.

punchline.text: Sync for answers now, async for work later.

quiz.question: What is an example of asynchronous communication?
